SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM , cbc.charge_code
, (SELECT IF(cbc.start_date <= NOW() AND cbc.expire_date >= NOW(), '운영', '종료')) AS status
, DATE_FORMAT(cbc.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date , DATE_FORMAT(cbc.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expire_date , DATE_FORMAT(cbc.regi_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS regi_date , cbc.charge_name , cbc.amount , cbc.sub_id , cbc.sales_count FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc, (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE cbc.charge_code LIKE '${CKeyword}%'
AND cbc.start_date <= NOW() AND cbc.expire_date >= NOW()
AND (cbc.start_date > NOW() OR cbc.expire_date < NOW())
AND cbc.charge_name LIKE UPPER('%${NKeyword}%') ORDER BY cbc.regi_date DESC ) RESULT_TB LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(charge_code) AS chargeTotal , COUNT(CASE WHEN start_date <= NOW() AND expire_date >= NOW() THEN 1 END) AS chargeOpr , COUNT(CASE WHEN start_date >= NOW() OR expire_date <= NOW() THEN 1 END) AS chargeEnd
FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE WHERE charge_code LIKE '${CKeyword}%'
AND start_date <= NOW() AND expire_date >= NOW()
AND (start_date > NOW() OR expire_date < NOW())
AND charge_name LIKE UPPER('%${NKeyword}%')
SELECT MAX(charge_code) AS chargeCode FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE WHERE charge_code LIKE CONCAT ('${charge_type}', '${sub_period}', '%')

SELECT charge_code , charge_name , charge_type , DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date , DATE_FORMAT(expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expire_date , sub_id , sales_count , product_count , amount , sub_period , sub_unit , charge_detail , DATE_FORMAT(regi_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS regi_date FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE WHERE charge_code = #{charge_code}

SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM , (SELECT IF(cpc.start_date <= NOW() AND cpc.end_date > NOW(), '운영', '종료')) AS status , DATE_FORMAT(cpc.start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date , IFNULL(cp.partner_code, 'CBCI') AS partner_code , IFNULL(cp.partner_nm, '자체') AS partner_nm , cpc.promo_name , cpc.promo_code , (SELECT SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE SELECT_CD = cpc.promo_target AND SELECT_CLASS = 'promotionTarget') as promo_target , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ccpc.charge_code ORDER BY ccpc.charge_code) AS charge_code_group FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc JOIN CBCI_CHARGE_PROMOTION_CONNECTION ccpc ON cbc.charge_code = ccpc.charge_code WHERE ccpc.promo_code = cpc.promo_code) AS charge_code , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cbc.charge_name ORDER BY ccpc.charge_code) AS charge_name_group FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc JOIN CBCI_CHARGE_PROMOTION_CONNECTION ccpc ON cbc.charge_code = ccpc.charge_code WHERE ccpc.promo_code = cpc.promo_code) AS charge_name , IFNULL(cpc.discount_rate, '') AS discount_rate , IFNULL(cpc.discount_amount, '') AS discount_amount , IFNULL(cpc.free_period, "") AS free_period , CASE WHEN (cpc.free_period_unit = 'M') THEN '개월' WHEN (cpc.free_period_unit = 'W') THEN '주' ELSE "" END AS free_period_unit , CASE WHEN (cpc.sub_id = '99') THEN '무제한' ELSE cpc.sub_id END AS sub_id FROM CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE cpc LEFT JOIN CBCI_PARTNER cp ON cpc.partner_code = cp.partner_code, (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE cpc.promo_code LIKE '%${PCKeyword}%' AND cpc.status LIKE '%${SKeyword}%' ORDER BY cpc.start_date DESC ) RESULT_TB WHERE RESULT_TB.partner_nm LIKE '%${PNKeyword}%' LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(RESULT_TB.promo_code) AS promoTotal , COUNT(CASE WHEN RESULT_TB.status = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS promoOpr , COUNT(CASE WHEN RESULT_TB.status = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS promoEnd FROM ( SELECT cpc.promo_code , cpc.status , IFNULL(cp.partner_nm, '자체') AS partner_nm FROM CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE cpc LEFT JOIN CBCI_PARTNER cp ON cpc.partner_code = cp.partner_code ) RESULT_TB WHERE RESULT_TB.promo_code LIKE '%${PCKeyword}%' AND RESULT_TB.status LIKE '%${SKeyword}%' AND RESULT_TB.partner_nm LIKE '%${PNKeyword}%'

SELECT cpc.promo_code , cpc.promo_name , DATE_FORMAT(cpc.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date , DATE_FORMAT(cpc.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date , DATE_FORMAT(cpc.input_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS input_date , cpc.promo_target , (SELECT DISTINCT csc.SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE cpc JOIN CBCI_SELECT_CODE csc ON SUBSTRING(cpc.partner_code, -4,2) = csc.SELECT_CD WHERE cpc.promo_code = #{promo_code}) AS partner_division , cpc.partner_code , IFNULL(cpc.free_period, '') AS free_period , IFNULL(cpc.free_period_unit, '') AS free_period_unit , cpc.sub_id , IFNULL(cpc.discount_rate, '') AS discount_rate , IFNULL(cpc.discount_amount, '') AS discount_amount , cpc.promo_detail , GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ccpc.charge_code ORDER BY ccpc.charge_code) AS charge_code_group FROM CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE cpc LEFT JOIN CBCI_CHARGE_PROMOTION_CONNECTION ccpc ON cpc.promo_code = ccpc.promo_code WHERE cpc.promo_code = #{promo_code} GROUP BY cpc.promo_code
SELECT SELECT_CD , SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE SELECT_CLASS = 'partnerType'
SELECT charge_code , charge_name FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE WHERE start_date <= NOW() AND expire_date > NOW() ORDER BY sub_id DESC
SELECT partner_code , partner_nm FROM CBCI_PARTNER WHERE partner_status = '00' AND partner_code LIKE '${partner_division}%'
SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(promo_code, 8, 9)) AS promoCode FROM CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE

SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT , RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUMa , (SELECT IF(cp.partner_status = '00', '운영', '종료')) AS partner_status , DATE_FORMAT(cp.input_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS input_date , (SELECT SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE SELECT_CD = SUBSTRING(cp.partner_code, -4, 2) AND SELECT_CLASS = 'partnerType') AS partner_type , cp.partner_nm , cp.partner_code , cp.rep_nm , cp.partner_id , cmi.manager_type , IFNULL(cmi.manager_nm, '') AS manager_nm , IFNULL(cmi.manager_phone, '') AS manager_phone FROM CBCI_PARTNER cp LEFT JOIN CBCI_MANAGER_INFO cmi ON cp.partner_code = cmi.partner_code AND cmi.manager_nm NOT IN (''), (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE UPPER(cp.partner_nm) LIKE UPPER('%${PNKeyword}%') AND UPPER(cp.partner_status) LIKE UPPER('%${PSKeyword}%') AND UPPER(cp.rep_nm) LIKE UPPER('%${RNKeyword}%') AND UPPER(cp.partner_code) LIKE UPPER('%${PCKeyword}%') AND IF((SELECT COUNT(IF(manager_nm = '', NULL, 1)) FROM CBCI_MANAGER_INFO WHERE partner_code = cp.partner_code) = 2, cmi.manager_type ='01', 1=1) ORDER BY cp.input_date DESC ) RESULT_TB LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(partner_id) AS partnerTotal , COUNT(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(partner_code, -4, 2)="BA" THEN 1 END) AS partnerTypeBA , COUNT(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(partner_code, -4, 2)="BB" THEN 1 END) AS partnerTypeBB , COUNT(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(partner_code, -4, 2)="CO" THEN 1 END) AS partnerTypeCO , COUNT(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(partner_code, -4, 2)="FI" THEN 1 END) AS partnerTypeFI , COUNT(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(partner_code, -4, 2)="MN" THEN 1 END) AS partnerTypeMN , COUNT(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(partner_code, -4, 2)="TH" THEN 1 END) AS partnerTypeTH FROM CBCI_PARTNER WHERE UPPER(partner_nm) LIKE UPPER('%${PNKeyword}%') AND UPPER(partner_status) LIKE UPPER('%${PSKeyword}%') AND UPPER(rep_nm) LIKE UPPER('%${RNKeyword}%') AND UPPER(partner_code) LIKE UPPER('%${PCKeyword}%')

SELECT cp.partner_id , cp.partner_code , cp.partner_nm , cp.rep_nm , cp.partner_zip , cp.partner_address , DATE_FORMAT(cp.input_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS input_date , cp.partner_status , cp.partner_type , cmi.manager_type , cmi.manager_nm , cmi.manager_rank , cmi.manager_email , cmi.manager_phone , cp.detail FROM CBCI_PARTNER cp LEFT JOIN CBCI_MANAGER_INFO cmi ON cp.partner_code = cmi.partner_code WHERE cp.partner_id = #{partner_id}
